# Heirstone Consulting

> Strategy advisory for real estate, tourism and national development across the Middle East, Africa and Central Asia, with offices in Dubai and Cairo. Publishes free research reports on these markets.

Heirstone Consulting & Strategic Advisory (Heirstone Consulting L.L.C-FZ, Meydan Grandstand, Dubai) advises governments, state and institutional investors and developers on market and feasibility studies, real estate and tourism strategy, national vision programmes, public-private partnerships, asset monetisation and digital transformation. Contact: info@heirstoneconsulting.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/heirstoneconsulting

## Practices

- [Real Estate Strategy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/real-estate-strategy): Heirstone delivers institutional-grade real estate strategy: market feasibility, highest-and-best-use studies, development strategy, and investment advisory.
- [Tourism Development](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/tourism-development): Expert tourism development strategy: destination planning, visitor economy frameworks, tourism master plans, and sector transformation for governments and developers.
- [National Vision Strategy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/national-vision-strategy): Strategic advisory for national development initiatives. Economic diversification, sector masterplanning, and vision execution.
- [Special Projects](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/special-projects): Bespoke strategic advisory for complex, high-value special projects. Heirstone brings senior expertise to challenges that don't fit standard frameworks.
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/digital-transformation): Advisory on digitising the government services real estate and construction depend on — permitting, land registry, service design and BIM standards — across MENA, Africa and Central Asia.

## Services

- [Airport, Port & Gateway Commercial Strategy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/airport-port-strategy): Commercial strategy for airports, cruise terminals and commercial ports — concept development, retail and concession mix, and highest and best use studies for gateway estates across MENA, Africa and Central Asia.
- [Asset Monetization](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/asset-monetization): Strategic advisory for asset monetisation, portfolio optimisation, and value extraction from real estate and infrastructure assets across Africa and the Middle East.
- [BIM, Digital Twins & Asset Information Standards](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/bim-digital-twins): Advisory on national BIM mandates, digital twin strategy and asset information standards for government construction and real estate portfolios across MENA, Africa and Central Asia.
- [Branded Residences Strategy Advisory](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/branded-residences): Strategic advisory for branded residential developments. Operator selection, brand alignment, programme design, and market positioning.
- [Commercial Feasibility Studies](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/commercial-feasibility): Rigorous commercial feasibility analysis for real estate developments, hotel projects, mixed-use schemes, and tourism attractions. Heirstone's feasibility studies are built for lenders and investors.
- [Competitive Benchmarking](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/competitive-benchmarking): Rigorous competitive benchmarking for real estate and tourism projects. Peer analysis, gap identification, and strategic positioning.
- [Cross-Border Expansion Advisory](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/cross-border-expansion): Market entry and cross-border expansion advisory for real estate and hospitality operators. Market selection, partnership strategy, and localisation.
- [Destination Brand](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/destination-brand): Strategic destination branding for cities, regions, and countries. Heirstone develops compelling place identities that attract visitors, investors, and talent.
- [Destination Strategy and Positioning](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/destination-strategy): Heirstone helps destinations define and execute competitive positioning strategies. Destination master planning, visitor segmentation, and product development.
- [Development Strategy & Phasing](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/development-strategy): End-to-end development strategy for real estate projects: product mix, phasing, positioning, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.
- [Digital Permitting & Construction Licensing](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/digital-permitting): Advisory on digitising building permits, construction licensing and compliance for government authorities across MENA, Africa and Central Asia — cutting approval time and making project pipelines visible.
- [Digital Service Design & Citizen Experience](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/digital-service-design): Service design advisory for government real estate, construction and land services — journey mapping, service standards and digital experience design across MENA, Africa and Central Asia.
- [Global Benchmarking](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/global-benchmarking): International benchmarking analysis drawing on global best practices in tourism development, real estate investment, and destination management.
- [Highest and Best Use Analysis](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/highest-and-best-use): Heirstone's highest-and-best-use analysis identifies the optimal development programme for any land or asset. Used by landowners, developers, and government entities.
- [Innovation Ecosystem Strategy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/innovation-ecosystem): Strategy for innovation districts, tech hubs, and knowledge economy development. Heirstone helps governments attract talent, firms, and investment into innovation ecosystems.
- [Investment Attraction & Structuring](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/investment-attraction): Strategic advisory to attract foreign direct investment into real estate, tourism, and urban development. Investor targeting, pitch preparation, and deal structuring support.
- [Investor Outreach](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/investor-outreach): Heirstone designs investor outreach strategies and roadshows for real estate and tourism projects targeting institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.
- [Land Registry & Property Transaction Digitization](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/land-registry-digitization): Strategic advisory on digitising land registries, cadastral records and property transactions for governments across MENA, Africa and Central Asia — securing tenure and unlocking mortgage and investment markets.
- [Market Research & Opportunity Identification](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/market-research): Proprietary market research for real estate and tourism sectors. Demand studies, competitive benchmarking, and market sizing across African and Middle Eastern markets.
- [Monitoring Frameworks](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/monitoring-frameworks): Heirstone designs KPI frameworks and monitoring systems to track the implementation and impact of national, sector, and project-level strategies.
- [National Vision](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/national-vision): Heirstone supports governments in designing and executing national vision strategies for real estate, tourism, and economic diversification.
- [Policy & Institutional Framework Advisory](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/policy-framework): Heirstone designs enabling policy frameworks for real estate investment, tourism development, and economic diversification.
- [Political Risk & Investment Climate Assessment](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/political-risk-assessment): Political, regulatory and investment-climate risk assessment for capital committed to frontier and high-growth markets across MENA, Africa and Central Asia — scoped to the investment decision, not security operations.
- [PPP Strategy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/ppp-strategy): Heirstone advises governments and private developers on structuring and executing public-private partnerships in real estate and tourism.
- [Sector Transformation](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/sector-transformation): Heirstone helps governments and investors drive sector-level transformation in tourism, real estate, and urban development.
- [Sports, Culture & Mega-Event Strategy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/sports-culture): Strategic advisory for sports, culture, and entertainment projects. Mega-event strategy, venue feasibility, and soft power positioning for governments and investors.
- [Tourism Market Research](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/tourism-market-research): Specialist tourism market research: visitor profiling, demand forecasting, competitor analysis, and market sizing for destinations and attractions.
- [Visitor Economy](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/visitor-economy): Comprehensive visitor economy frameworks for destinations. Heirstone analyses visitor flows, spending patterns, and opportunity gaps to drive economic impact.

## Research reports

Free PDFs, sent by email from each report page. Each page carries the key findings, figures and FAQs.

### The Africa Series

- [Real Estate Capital in Africa: The money is already here](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-real-estate-capital): Who funds African real estate in local currency, why so little of it reaches property, and when borrowing in dollars still makes sense, across 14 currencies from Egypt and Morocco to Nigeria, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire and South Africa. (English, French)
- [Diaspora Buyers: The absent owner](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-diaspora-buyers): How money and buyers from abroad shape housing demand, prices and vacancy in African cities, from Cairo, Casablanca and Tangier to Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Dakar, Addis Ababa and Praia. (English, French)
- [Africa Regional Headquarters: Where Africa is run from](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-regional-headquarters): Reach, cost, currency and talent in the choice of an Africa headquarters, and why the job is now split between cities, tested on 16 African cities from Casablanca and Cairo to Nairobi, Johannesburg and Abidjan, with Dubai as a benchmark. (English, French)
- [Flexible Workspace: Renting the brand](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-flexible-workspace): How flexible-office operators are handing the fit-out and the risk back to building owners, and which structure suits landlords from Cairo and Casablanca to Lagos, Nairobi, Abidjan and the Gulf. (English, French)
- [Retail Real Estate in Africa: The market is the anchor](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-retail-real-estate): Open-air markets, shopping malls and who wins retail real estate in North and Sub-Saharan Africa, from Cairo and Casablanca to Lagos, Accra, Abidjan, Nairobi and Dar es Salaam. (English, French)
- [Hotel Development in Africa: Hotels on paper](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-hotel-development): Why Africa's chain hotel pipeline has never been larger while the rooms opened each year fell by more than half between 2017 and 2023, with a test for telling a hotel that will open from one that will not, from Egypt and Morocco to Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya and Ethiopia. (English, French)
- [Digital Infrastructure Real Estate: Borrowed ground](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-digital-infrastructure): Towers, fibre and the land beneath Africa's digital networks, and why the ground lease and the wayleave are their weak links, from Nigeria, South Africa and Kenya to Egypt, Morocco, Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire. (English, French)
- [Worker Housing in African Industrial Parks: Factories need beds](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-worker-housing): Africa's industrial parks were planned around sheds, power and tax incentives, and the workers' beds were left to the market. A benchmark of 17 zones in ten countries, from Ethiopia's Hawassa and Egypt's 10th of Ramadan to Tangier, Kenya and Benin, with the arithmetic of a rental bed. (English, French)
- [Universities and Student Housing in Africa: The bed behind the seat](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-student-housing): Africa's 18 to 24 year-olds, the universities competing to teach them and the economics of the student bed in 15 countries, from Cairo and Algiers to Lagos, Nairobi and Pretoria. (English, French)
- [Private Schools in Africa: The empty seat](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-schools-education): Private primary and secondary schools in Africa read as real estate: seats, land, capital per place and tenure across 13 markets, from Egypt and Morocco to Nigeria, Côte d'Ivoire, Kenya and South Africa. (English, French)
- [Industrial Cities and Exports: The port is the cheap part](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-industrial-cities-exports): How industrial zones, ports and the cities around them build an export base in Africa, from Tanger Med and Kenitra in Morocco to Sokhna in Egypt, Nkok in Gabon, Glo-Djigbé in Benin and Diamniadio in Senegal. (English, French)
- [Agro-Industrial Zones in North and Sub-Saharan Africa: The crop comes first](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-agro-industrial-zones): Agro-industrial parks and agropoles: what they have delivered, and where processing in Africa actually happens. A register of 20 zones in 12 countries, from Morocco and Egypt to Nigeria, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin and Ethiopia. (English, French)
- [Trade Corridors in Africa: Where cargo stops](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-trade-corridors): Ports, dry ports, border towns and junctions after the African Continental Free Trade Area, and where warehousing and industrial land should follow, from Morocco and Egypt to Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, Nigeria and Côte d'Ivoire. (English, French)
- [Mining Towns: The fence and the city](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-mining-towns): What African mining towns become during and after the mine, and what decides whether a mine leaves a city or a ghost town, from the Zambian and Congolese Copperbelt to Botswana, Ghana, Tanzania, Morocco and Guinea. (English, French)
- [Air Access and Tourism in Africa: Empty seats, full terminals](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-air-access-tourism): Seats, routes, fares, taxes, visas and open skies: what really limits tourist arrivals in North and Sub-Saharan Africa, from Marrakech and the Red Sea to Cape Town and Zanzibar, and what governments, airports and investors can change. (English, French)
- [State Resort Programmes, Twenty Years On: The plan and the beach](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-state-resort-programmes): What North and West Africa's state resort programmes promised and built, from Morocco's Plan Azur and Egypt's TDA zones to Tunisia, Senegal and Cabo Verde, and what the record says to the Red Sea and Mediterranean giga-projects now under way. (English, French)
- [Conservation Tourism in Africa: The bed and the hectare](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-conservation-tourism): What high-value, low-volume tourism earns per bed and per hectare in Kenya, Rwanda, Botswana, Tanzania and Namibia, who is paid for the land, and what it would take to make the model work in North Africa. (English, French)
- [Diaspora and Heritage Travel in Africa: The return ticket](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-diaspora-heritage-travel): What homecoming travel is worth to Africa, how much of it falls in a single season, and what it does to hotels, short lets, heritage towns and coastal property, from Ghana, Nigeria and Benin to Morocco, Egypt and Kenya. (English, French)
- [Meetings and Conventions in Africa: The price of a plenary seat](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-meetings-conventions): What international meetings are worth to an African capital and what a convention centre has to carry to win them, from Cairo, Marrakech and Abidjan to Nairobi, Kigali and Cape Town. (English, French)
- [Construction Costs and Building Technology: Nine cities, one square metre](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-construction-costs): What it costs to build a square metre in nine African cities, why the costs differ and when building technology brings them down, from Lagos, Abidjan and Kinshasa to Nairobi, Dar es Salaam and Casablanca, with Cairo as the comparator. (English, French)
- [Contractors and Building Materials: Who pours the concrete](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-africa-contractors-materials): Who builds Africa's large projects, who pays for them and where the cement and steel come from, from Chinese and Turkish contractors to Egypt's builders abroad and the EU carbon border on the Mediterranean. (English, French)

### Middle East and Mediterranean

- [Branded Residences: Who keeps the premium](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-branded-residences): What a brand adds to a home after its fees and running costs, and where branded schemes fall short, with a view from the UAE, Egypt and Saudi Arabia. (English)
- [Surplus State Property: The second price](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-surplus-state-property): Releasing surplus state land and buildings without giving the value away: evidence from 27 named releases and five national estates, and the routes now in use in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Morocco. (English)
- [Marinas and Yacht Waterfronts: The berth is not the business](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-marinas): Superyachts, marinas and the economics of the yacht waterfront, with a view from the Gulf, the Red Sea and Egypt, built on a benchmark of 37 marinas from Tangier to Muscat. (English)
- [Seasonal Coastal Cities: Beyond August](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-seasonal-coastal-cities): What turns a resort coast into a year-round city, measured across 31 resort towns, and what it means for Egypt's North Coast, Ras El Hekma and the Saudi Red Sea. (English)
- [Heritage Destinations: The gate and the night](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-heritage-destinations): Why heritage sites draw record crowds while the land around them keeps little of what visitors spend, and what that land should hold, with a view from Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider region. (English)
- [Cruise and Ferry Terminals: Guaranteed Passage](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-cruise-ferry-terminals): Cruise and ferry terminals as real estate and infrastructure, and a test of when a sea gate earns its land in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. (English)
- [Event Venues and Legacy: Planning for day two](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-event-venues-legacy): What became of 30 Olympic, Expo and World Cup sites after the crowds left, and what the Gulf and Egypt can settle now for the venues they are building next. (English)
- [Airports and Terminals: The busiest hour](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-airports-terminals): How airports work, how to compare them fairly across regions and what makes a good one, with a view from the Mediterranean, Africa and Central Asia. (English, French, Russian)

### Central Asia

- [Resort Economies in Kyrgyzstan: Fifty-two weekends](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-kyrgyzstan-resort-economies): Issyk-Kul, Kyrgyzstan's summer lake, and what fills a resort's other months, measured against lake and mountain peers from Balaton to Shymbulak, with the Chatkal cluster beside Tashkent. (English, Russian)
- [New Cities in Uzbekistan: The daytime city](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/report-uzbekistan-new-cities): New Tashkent, the capital's housing and office boom, and what makes a new city beside a capital fill, measured against 23 new cities from Cairo to Astana. (English, Russian)

## Insights

- [Highest and Best Use Analysis: A Practical Guide](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/highest-and-best-use-analysis): A practical guide to highest and best use analysis: the four tests, the process, typical outputs, common mistakes and when to commission an HBU study.
- [Building a National Tourism Strategy That Mobilises Investment](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/national-tourism-development-strategy): How governments build a national tourism development strategy that mobilises private investment — demand forecasting, positioning, product and governance.
- [Real Estate Strategy in Frontier Markets](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/real-estate-strategy-frontier-markets): How real estate strategy consulting works in frontier markets: building defensible strategy in MENA and Africa when conventional data and models fail.

## Company

- [About Heirstone Consulting](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/about): Learn about Heirstone Consulting's team, methodology, and approach to delivering strategy for real estate developers, tourism authorities, and governments globally.
- [Selected Team Experience](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/experience): Representative mandates delivered by the Heirstone team across sovereign, institutional and private-sector clients — from the Pyramids of Giza masterplan to national tourism programmes, giga-project strategy and frontier-market feasibility.
- [Research Reports](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/reports): Free Heirstone research on real estate, infrastructure and tourism in Africa, the Middle East and Central Asia: 31 reports from Egypt and Nigeria to Uzbekistan.
- [Insights](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/insights): Practical insight from Heirstone Consulting on real estate strategy, tourism development and national vision strategy across MENA, Africa and Central Asia.
- [Contact Us](https://www.heirstoneconsulting.com/pages/contact): Get in touch with Heirstone Consulting for real estate strategy, tourism development, or national vision advisory services. Based globally, serving emerging markets.
